text:
nina: quick FYI — spotted a doc + example drift on the Dedicated k8s annotation section. the example still shows the old pod annotation `redwood.io/preempt: \"false\"` which the kube-operator ignores now.
omar: where's the example? PR?
nina: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5421 i pushed an edit but sims + staging operator behaved differently than the snippet claims
priya: can you paste the failing snippet and the command you used to test?
nina: snippet from docs (current):
```yaml
# docs/examples/dedicated/k8s-pool.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood.io/preempt: "false"
spec:
  containers:
    - name: worker
      image: redwood/dedicated-worker:stable
```
nina: test command: `kubectl apply -f docs/examples/dedicated/k8s-pool.yaml && ./dev-tools/wait-for-pool --pool reporting --timeout 60s`
docs-ci: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/k8s-annotations-5421
omar: runtime change note: the operator now reads `redwood.io/eviction-policy` (enum: ALLOW_EVICT | NO_EVICT) and prefers `redwood.io/isolation-decorators` JSON blob instead of the old flat labels/annotations. old annotation is ignored — that explains the mismatch.
priya: thanks. let's update the example and add a short migration mapping. also add a small Rust SDK snippet for variety (we have py/go/js elsewhere).
nina: updated PR with corrected YAML and migration blurb, but CI flagged linkcheck for a cross-doc anchor and docs-lint complained about missing language tag on the Rust snippet
priya: can you paste the corrected snippet you pushed?
nina: corrected YAML pushed:
```yaml
# docs/examples/dedicated/k8s-pool.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood.io/eviction-policy: "NO_EVICT"
    redwood.io/isolation-decorators: "[{\"tenant\": \"reporting\"}]"
spec:
  containers:
    - name: worker
      image: redwood/dedicated-worker:stable
```
priya: looks good. SDK snippet (Rust) that I added to the PR: please include ```rust language tag so CI is happy.
```rust
use redwood_dedicated::client::Client;
use redwood_dedicated::types::{CapacityPool, EvictionPolicy, IsolationDecorator};

let mut client = Client::new();
let pool = CapacityPool::new()
    .reserved(true)
    .eviction_policy(EvictionPolicy::NoEvict)
    .isolation_decorators(vec![IsolationDecorator::from_kv("tenant", "reporting")]);
client.create_capacity_pool(pool).await?;
```
docs-ci: linkcheck failed: /docs/dedicated#k8s-annotations anchor missing (404). docs-lint: codeblock missing language tag on one YAML example (please add `yaml`).
omar: i'll add the missing anchor in the K8s annotations page and fix the YAML fence. also add a tiny examples-parse unit test that loads docs/examples/ and validates required keys are present (eviction vs preempt).
nina: added test reference in PR description and a migration table: "Map `redwood.io/preempt` -> `redwood.io/eviction-policy` (ALLOW_EVICT | NO_EVICT); if you used `labels` in annotations, move them to `redwood.io/isolation-decorators` as a JSON array of objects."
priya: pinging @omar for quick review on the Rust snippet wording; once green i'll squash and merge. thanks :sparkles:
deploy-bot: preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/k8s-annotations-5421 (checks pending)
